notes: Draft tagged the deck Light; the post is tagged Dark and Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe is a Dark Objective, so the deck is Dark (the author plays the Objective flipped).

Starting cards as posted under 'starting (8)': the Objective, Death Star, Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Prepared Defenses, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, A Million Voices Crying Out and Mobilization Points; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Alderaan' and 'Docking Bay 327' dested the Dark printings Alderaan (Dark) and Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'Death Star War Room' dested Death Star: War Room.
Posted 'Executer' dested Executor; 'Visage' (listed under Ships) dested the starship Visage, not Visage Of The Emperor.

Posted 'Monnok' dested the Interrupt Monnok (not the Evader & Monnok combo); 'Put All Sections On Allert' dested Put All Sections On Alert; 'Commence Primary Ignation' dested Commence Primary Ignition; 'I've Lost Artoo' dested I've Lost Artoo!; 'Mobilisation Points' dested Mobilization Points.
Posted 'Come Here You Big Coward' (under Effects) dested the Special Edition Effect, not the later Reflections III Defensive Shield.
Byline posted in lower case ('alex "scam4ever" klimo'); capitalized as Alex Klimo, the existing wiki player who also posted 'speeder bikes on tatooine' (DeckTech 20358) as scam4ever.
